images.filename: Destructions in Dnipro after Russian attack, 2025-03-28 (21).jpg
images.caption: Remains of a ship in hotel-restaurant complex Bartolomeo, Dnipro city, after Russian attack on the city with 20 drones in the evening of 28 March 2025. Four people died and 24 were injured. A hotel-restaurant complex, 11 private houses, garages and car service station caught fire. Besides this, a number of multi-storey houses and 21 cars were damaged  (1, 2, 3).
images.alt: Remains of a ship in hotel-restaurant complex Bartolomeo, Dnipro city, after Russian attack on the city with 20 drones in the evening of 28 March 2025. Besides this, a number of multi-storey houses and 21 cars were damaged  (1, 2, 3).

images.alt: Kindergarten in Dnipro after Russian missile attack on the city on 24 June 2025. 21 people were killed and approximately 300 injured in the city. Dozens of houses and other objects were damaged, including the Odesa — Zaporizhzhia passenger train (1, 2).

images.filename: Lapidarium of Dnipropetrovs'k Museum of Local History 03 (YDS 6897).jpg
images.caption: Polovtsian stone statues presented in the lapidarium from the collection of kurgan monumental sculpture of Dnipropetrovsk national historical museum named to D.I.Yavornytskiy. The museum collection started to form in the middle of 19th century and includes 67 statues of different historical epochs, i.e. steles of Eneolithic and bronze epochs dated by III-II millennium B.C., Scythian steles and statues dated by V — IV century B.C., Sarmatian statue, gothic stele dated by III-IV century A.D., but the major part of the collection is presented by Polovtsian statues of high work of art dated by XI — XIII century A.D.
images.alt: Polovtsian stone statues presented in the lapidarium from the collection of kurgan monumental sculpture of Dnipropetrovsk national historical museum named to D.I.Yavornytskiy. The museum collection started to form in the middle of 19th century and includes 67 statues of different historical epochs, i.e. steles of Eneolithic and bronze epochs dated by III-II millennium B.C., Scythian steles and statues dated by V — IV century B.C., Sarmatian statue, gothic stele dated by III-IV century A.D., but the major part of the collection is presented by Polovtsian statues of high work of art dated by XI — XIII century A.D.
